statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-23454 is specifically about org.apache.hadoop.util.RunJar.run() not setting safe permissions on its temporary directory, which is only invoked by Hadoop's own `hadoop jar` CLI launcher. This image's entrypoint (image/spark-dependencies/bin/entrypoint.sh) launches the job jar directly via `java -jar`, never through RunJar/`hadoop jar`. The CVE's threat model is also a shared, multi-tenant host where other local users can read the shared system temp directory; this job always runs as the sole process in its own container.
